lyrics.ti:
[[chorus]]
ናትና መመክሒት ኣምላኽ ዝወለድኪ /2/
ኦ ድንግል ኣዴና ዝተባረኪ’ኺ
[[/chorus]]

[[highlight]]ኣማን ብኣማን /2/ ኣደ ናይ ጐይታና[[/highlight]]
ንኣምን በኣኺ ንምህጸን ብስምኪ ድንግል ኣማልድና

[[highlight]]ነቢያት ኩላቶም ድንግል ዝበሉኺ /2/[[/highlight]]
ደመና ናይ ኤልያስ ማርያም ንስኺ’ኺ

[[highlight]]ኣዲኦም ንጻድቃን ሓፍቶም ንመላእክት/2/[[/highlight]]
ብናትኪ ቃልኪዳን ረኺብና ሕይወት

[[highlight]]ሓዊ ከየንደዳ ሙሴ ዝረኣያ /2/[[/highlight]]
ዝለምለመት ቆጽሊ ድንግል ማርያም እያ

[[highlight]]ኣደ ድንግልና ኣምላኽ ዝሃበኪ /2/[[/highlight]]
ምሕረት ኣውርድልና ንዓና ደቅኺ
lyrics.ti_ro:
[[chorus]]
Natna memekhit ʾamlakh ziweledki /2/
ʾO dingil ʾadena zitebareki’khi
[[/chorus]]

[[highlight]]ʾAman biʾaman /2/ ʾade nay goytana[[/highlight]]
Niʾamn beʾakhi nimhitsen bismiki dingil ʾamaldina

[[highlight]]Nebiyat kulatom dingil zibelukhi /2/[[/highlight]]
Demena nay ʾElyas Maryam niskhi’khi

[[highlight]]ʾAdiʾom nitsadqan haftom nimelaʾikt/2/[[/highlight]]
Binatki qalkidan rekhibna hiywet

[[highlight]]Hawi keyendeda Muse zireʾaya /2/[[/highlight]]
Zilemlemet qotsli dingil Maryam ʾiya

[[highlight]]ʾAde dingilna ʾamlakh zihabeki /2/[[/highlight]]
Mihret ʾawridlina niʿana deqkhi
